main.description: A lightweight membership record linking a media item to a collection list. Status, rating, notes, and review data live on the useritem record.

creator.description: Creator/author of the media (e.g., book author, film director).

mediaItemId.description: Reference to media_items table for aggregated data.

mediaType.description: Type of media: book, movie, tv, podcast, article, game, music, course, video, etc.

order.description: Display order within the list. Higher numbers appear first (top). 0 appears at bottom.

userItem.description: Reference (AT-URI) to the user's app.collectivesocial.feed.useritem record for this media item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this list item was created.
